en: The case began <CLT=cltSTRONG>last night<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

After being convinced by Miu, we all
logged in to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Virtual World<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

To log in, you have to plug the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>memory and conciousness cords<CLT=cltNORMAL> into the device.

So we all plugged those cords into our
helmets and entered the Virtual World.

But the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> had accidentally plugged
their cords into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wrong ports<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Because of this, a connection <CLT=cltSTRONG>error<CLT=cltNORMAL> occurred
between the culprit's brain and their avatar...

As a result, the culprit would <CLT=cltSTRONG>forget<CLT=cltNORMAL> everything
that happened in the Virtual World.

It's possible...that this had an effect
on their avatar's personality as well.

Because I...I can't believe that someone
so kind could commit murder...

But...we had no idea this error even happened.
And so, we all logged in one by one.
Meanwhile, <CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu<CLT=cltNORMAL> was the last to log in.

She had modified the killing game simulator
so she could accomplish a specific goal.

After Miu confirmed we were all logged in,
she took out the <CLT=cltSTRONG>bottle of poison<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
...and placed it on <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's seat<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This was done to make it look like Kokichi
was killed by poison when we returned.

Yes... The reason Miu modified the simulator
and brought us to the Virtual World...

...was to <CLT=cltSTRONG>kill Kokichi in the Virtual World<CLT=cltNORMAL>, but
make it look like he had <CLT=cltSTRONG>died in the real world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

After we had all logged in, Miu explained the
world to us.

"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Use the salon phone to log out, objects are
unbreakable, your avatars use all five senses<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...

She also explained the <CLT=cltSTRONG>map<CLT=cltNORMAL> of the Virtual World
in the mansion's entrance hall.

But her explanation was intentionally false.
She wanted us to misunderstand the world.

However...one of us was able to
see through her scheme.

The very person Miu was trying
to kill...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Kokichi was going to use Miu's plan
against her, and plotted her murder!

But Kokichi wouldn't do it himself. He used
a patsy to be the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> in this case.

Kokichi was tight-lipped about the motive...
so I don't know why the culprit agreed.

But it seems as though, right after logging in,
when Kokichi and the culprit went outside...

...they were already <CLT=cltSTRONG>working together<CLT=cltNORMAL> 
to execute the murder.

Eventually, we met up with Kokichi and
crossed the river to the chapel.

Miu had us split up to try to find
some "<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>."

Kaito, Kokichi, Gonta, Tsumugi, and I
investigated the mansion...

...while Maki, Himiko, Keebo, and Miu
investigated the chapel.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Splitting us up<CLT=cltNORMAL> was also part of Miu's plan.

At the chapel, Miu told Maki that she was
going to <CLT=cltSTRONG>look around outside<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She chased after our group while we were
heading toward the mansion.

Once she made sure we were across, she
<CLT=cltSTRONG>dropped the bridge into the river<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This was to trick us into thinking that the
river separated the mansion and chapel.

At the time, we thought nothing of it...
It was just another one of Miu's pranks.

That's why we continued with the original
plan to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

We went to the mansion and split up
to look for <CLT=cltSTRONG>clues<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Kokichi searched the salon.
Kaito searched the roof.
Tsumugi searched the dining room.
I searched the kitchen.

And finally, the culprit searched
<CLT=cltSTRONG>outside the mansion<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Around that time, Miu was headed for the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>wall<CLT=cltNORMAL> that was on the side of the chapel.

She passed through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wall<CLT=cltNORMAL> and
headed for the mansion to kill Kokichi.

You see, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wall<CLT=cltNORMAL> was a special wall that
Miu had added herself.

This wall was programmed so that <CLT=cltSTRONG>only objects
could pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...and Miu had changed her avatar's settings
from "<CLT=cltSTRONG>human<CLT=cltNORMAL>" to "<CLT=cltSTRONG>object<CLT=cltNORMAL>."

That was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden route<CLT=cltNORMAL> she prepared for
herself.

She set up a <CLT=cltSTRONG>wall<CLT=cltNORMAL> that only she could pass
through!

Miu headed toward the mansion, but she
was seen by Tsumugi on the way...

When she entered the mansion, she pulled
out her <CLT=cltSTRONG>cell phone<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She didn't tell us that there was
another way to log out...

Then, she spoke a name into the phone,
which <CLT=cltSTRONG>forced that person to log out<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
It was <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito<CLT=cltNORMAL>, who was on the roof at the time.

The same roof where Kokichi and Miu
were going to meet.

By having Kaito search the roof, and
then forcing him to log out...

...she was making him look the most suspicious.
But her plan didn't go smoothly.

Kokichi was waiting on the roof with the
culprit, and the toilet paper used to kill Miu.

While Miu was distracted by Kokichi,
the culprit snuck up from behind...

And used the <CLT=cltSTRONG>toilet paper<CLT=cltNORMAL> from
the mansion's bathroom to strangle Miu.

This was only possible because <CLT=cltSTRONG>objects
in the Virtual World are unbreakable<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Miu's avatar was <CLT=cltSTRONG>strangled to death<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and the
shock killed Miu in the real world.

After the murder, Kokichi left the cleanup
to the culprit and left the roof.

He probably returned to the salon as soon
as he could to avoid drawing suspicion.

The culprit then took the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lattice<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from the storage room...

...and placed Miu's body on top, along
with the hammer and the cell phone.

The culprit heaved the lattice over the railing
and forcefully slid it down the roof's slope.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>With a body on top of it<CLT=cltNORMAL>, the lattice became
a makeshift sled and flew off the roof.

It went through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wall that only objects can
pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL> before crashing into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>chapel<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>crashing sound<CLT=cltNORMAL> that Keebo heard
in the chapel, and we heard in the mansion.

Miu's wall hid the fact that the mansion and
chapel were actually right next to each other.

That's why Tsumugi and I were able
to hear the crash from the mansion!

As the final step, the culprit had to then
get off the roof.

Because we were at the mansion, they
couldn't take the stairs or they'd be seen.

So they used the <CLT=cltSTRONG>toilet paper<CLT=cltNORMAL> again
to escape from the rooftop.

They hung the toilet paper from the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>binoculars<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the roof...
...and used it <CLT=cltSTRONG>like a rope<CLT=cltNORMAL> to climb down.

Once the culprit was safely on the ground,
they pulled at the toilet paper to retrieve it.

They would have returned it to the bathroom, but
they ran into us as we were leaving the mansion.

In a panic, the culprit <CLT=cltSTRONG>tossed<CLT=cltNORMAL> the toilet paper
somewhere nearby.
Without that one little mistake...

...we might never have solved this case, because
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit doesn't remember<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This is the truth you've forgotten!
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Gonta Gokuhara, the Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
